role: fixed historical source data interface and bounded simulation pilot; no source design or target comparison
registration_context: Complete 2024 population inspected: 28/154 joint candidates have 219/219 successes under both rules; all paired service indicators and successful costs agree. No 2023 announced-controller outcomes observed. Earlier isolated 2023 BOA/physical availability probes are retained.
source_period_basis: Reuse the two candidate ten-day source periods fixed in public_battery_dispatch_preflight_20260930.json; no source-period selection after outcomes.

data_budget.forecast_and_price: Ten days plus two-hour boundary, unchanged earliest national forecast and APXMIDP; no actual-demand, SOC, PN, MEL/MIL or confirmation requests.
data_budget.acceptances: Both original BM units, one-day prefix, original two-day API chunks; trim inclusive endpoints.

library: All original 154 candidates retained, original mapping/seed/rounding; no target-informed subset for source selection.
structural_geometry: Two independent ordered-channel cosine blocks, 18 coordinates each; concatenate coordinates, not the raw channels. Check channel swap and constant continuity before outcomes. No source ranks or design selection in this phase.

pilot.selection: First original constant; saved 0.45/0.75 interface anchor; first original functional and its existing swapped counterpart. Diagnostic anchors only, not a source library restriction.
pilot.failure_stopping: Unchanged saved population execute/validate/economics and already-passed stopping equivalence; all failed full costs remain null.

execution: One scheduler task per pilot cell with disjoint output; all 32 submitted together after source-data coverage and structural tests pass. Full journals and raw API caches stay on server. No new component simulations in tests.
gate: Data coverage, all 146 original source windows, forecast publication cutoffs, supported receipt timestamps, request accounting and energy accounting must pass. Pilot service failures are results, not interface failures. No retuning or dropping cells.
decision: Use complete saved pilot support to define valid source scoring and target objectives before freezing the full source archive or any source-benefit comparison. Keep HOLD.
limitations: Observed-data analyst simulation with notice/reset assumptions and overlapping windows. Pilots are diagnostic anchors chosen after 2024 development; no independent confirmation. Failed paths have undefined full costs, so the existing finite-objective atlas is not yet connected.
